sets.relationshipLabel: a structure and a feature it simply has
sets.explanation: A house has a chimney and a fireplace has a mantel — each pair is a whole paired with a part it ordinarily includes.
baitTags: chimney overlaps thematically with the sign set's smoking chimney

sets.relationshipLabel: a category and a specific kind within it
sets.explanation: Peat is a kind of fuel and a twig is a kind of kindling, so each pair sets a broad category beside one specific member of it.

sets.relationshipLabel: base and top of one rising structure, in construction order
sets.explanation: A firebox rises to a chimney cap and a keel rises to a masthead — each pair runs low-to-high in the order the structure is actually built.
baitTags: firebox and chimney cap echo the plain house/chimney whole-part set

sets.relationshipLabel: a visible sign and the fact or danger it announces
sets.explanation: A smoking chimney signals a house is occupied and black smoke signals a creosote fire — each visible sign necessarily points to the fact it announces.
baitTags: smoking chimney and occupied house echo the plain whole-part set's house and chimney
